A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same CSA research work, with all 16 pages and Appendices A–E available. Text comparison and rendered-page checks support comparison of the equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original numerical simulations in Section 5, benchmark experiments in Section 6, and audio-text and sensitivity results in Appendices B–E.

after.justification: v2 retains these original simulations, benchmark experiments, and appendix results.

M1.justification: Sections 3–4 retain the same frozen unimodal encoders, CCA projections, dimension selection, weighted cosine similarity, and fitting and inference procedures.

E1.justification: Both retain ImageNet classification and label-error detection, Leafy Spurge classification, Flickr30k retrieval, COSMOS misinformation detection, and MusicCaps audio-text evaluation. The synthetic simulations and noisy-data scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within each experiment: ASIF and CLIP in the image-text comparisons, LLaVA in detection experiments, the supervised COSMOS method in misinformation detection, and CLAP in Appendix B.

E3.justification: Training sizes, split descriptions, encoder configurations, metrics, threshold sweeps, and testing procedures are unchanged in Section 6 and Appendices A–E. No additional evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: Both retain the dimension trade-off simulation, shuffled-label robustness experiment, feature-correlation analysis, sensitivity to s, and alternative-encoder experiments in Figure 2, Figure 6, and Appendices C–E.

E5.justification: Figure 2 retains the same similarity-score boxplots and Wilcoxon p-values. Neither version changes repeated-run or seed information, uncertainty reporting, or statistical testing procedures.

E6.justification: All reported result entries, curves, and findings are unchanged, including the appendix results. For example, Table 2 retains CSA's 36.6% image-to-text mAP@5 and 44.7% text-to-image Precision@1; Figure 7 retains AUC 0.94 for both CSA and CLAP.

T1.justification: Equations 1–11, the data-generation and augmentation assumptions, the linear-encoder derivation, and the singular-value distance argument are unchanged. No mathematical definition, proof, or theoretical correction is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about data-efficient multimodal mapping, the theoretical trade-off, performance against CLIP and ASIF, and extension beyond image-text modalities.

C2.justification: The explanation of retrieval underperformance and the distinguishability–informativeness trade-off is unchanged. Both retain the same limitations concerning bimodal operation, CPU-based optimization, and dependence on capable unimodal encoders.

D1.justification: Appendix A retains the same encoder checkpoints, CCA Zoo implementation, hardware, runtime, and dataset split descriptions. No implementation or code/data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The cited works and their scientific positioning remain the same. Li et al. (2023) becomes Li et al. (2024a), and several references receive metadata updates, but no cited work or substantive relationship to prior research changes.

P1.justification: v2 revises three bibliography entries, including author-name forms, publication metadata, and arXiv reference formatting, with corresponding Li citation year/suffix updates. The version/date stamp changes; the narrative and section structure otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Citation and bibliography edits slightly change line wrapping on pages 2, 3, and 12. Figures 1–10 and Tables 1–3 retain identical content, formatting, captions, and placement, including in the appendices.

improvement.justification: v2 makes limited bibliographic and presentation updates while retaining the same method, theory, experimental evidence, reproducibility details, and limitations throughout the main text and appendices. These editorial changes do not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
